newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CANTV rate increase delayed again.
newsitem.headline: CANTV rate increase delayed again.

text.p: Scheduled third quarter rate increases for Venezuelan telephone company CANTV have been delayed again as the company has still not provided all the required information, Transport and Communications Minister Moises Orozco Graterol said.
"We were still receiving information from CANTV last night and there's not been enough time to evaluate it all," Orozco told reporters after the weekly cabinet meeting.
"We've decided the tariff increase will not be approved while we're unsure as to the true structure of (the company's) costs," he added.

CANTV has asked for an average 1.98 percent tariff increase for the quarter beginning July 1. A second quarter 4.18 percent rate increase, due under the 1991 concession agreement, was similarly delayed and only finally granted on April 14.
